One checklist row

Source: R/steps.R
kit_check.Rd

An S3 value object (class kit_check): its content is checked when it is built; it has an htmltools::as.tags() method, so putting it straight into a page renders <li class="kit-check">. Usually placed inside kit_checklist().

Usage

kit_check(state = c("todo", "ok", "note"), title, why = "", actions = NULL)

# S3 method for class 'kit_check'
as.tags(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'kit_check'
format(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'kit_check'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

state

"todo", "ok", or "note".

title

One sentence (a string).

why

The small print below (why); "" or length 0 shows nothing. (kitJoin's kitsdata_check() calls it text.)

actions

Buttons for the decision (a tag or list of tags); placed below the explanation.

x

A kit_check object.

...

Not used.

Value

A kit_check object.

Details

A mark on the left, preceded by hidden text (read by screen readers):

  • "todo": ! needs a decision ("要決定：", "To decide:"). One bold sentence, a line of small print below saying why, and the decision buttons below that.

  • "ok": ✓ fine, or already decided ("沒問題：", "OK:"). Font weight 500.

  • "note": i a reminder, no decision needed ("提醒：", "Note:").

Put the recommended option first and write "（建議）" ("(recommended)") on its button.

Examples

kit_check("todo", "有 3 題的分數從 1 開始", "kits 要的分數是 0、1、2…。")
#> ! 有 3 題的分數從 1 開始（kits 要的分數是 0、1、2…。）
# "3 items have scores starting at 1" / "kits needs scores 0, 1, 2…"
htmltools::as.tags(kit_check("ok", "45 題的分數都是整數"))  # "All 45 items have integer scores"
#> <li class="kit-check ok">
#>   <span class="kit-check-mark" aria-hidden="true">✓</span>
#>   <span class="visually-hidden">沒問題：</span>
#>   <div class="kit-check-text">
#>     <strong>45 題的分數都是整數</strong>
#>   </div>
#> </li>
